Package testBase.documetation

Class PDFHeaderFooterPageEvent

java.lang.Object
com.itextpdf.text.pdf.PdfPageEventHelper
testBase.documetation.PDFHeaderFooterPageEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.itextpdf.text.pdf.PdfPageEvent
public class PDFHeaderFooterPageEvent extends com.itextpdf.text.pdf.PdfPageEventHelper
PDFHeaderFooterPageEvent is a class that represents a page event helper for adding headers and footers to a PDF document. The PDFHeaderFooterPageEvent class extends the PdfPageEventHelper class to add header and footer to a PDF document.
